::: {.remark .notes}

$y_i$ is the coordinate of $\vx - \vecf{\mean}$ along the eigenvector $\vecf{q}_i$.
So the set of points at Mahalanobis distance $\mahaldist$ from $\vecf{\mean}$,
where the multivariate normal density is constant (@cor-mvn-mahalanobis),
is an ellipse ($p = 2$) or ellipsoid
centered at $\vecf{\mean}$,
with axes along the eigenvectors of $\matr{\covmat}$
and half-length $\mahaldist\sqrt{\eigval_i}$ along $\vecf{q}_i$.

:::
